warnings: Type schedule with a printed จำนวน (count) per type — count is the printed number. Marks kept as printed (ป = door, น = window).

Widths: where two widths are printed (1.00/0.90, 0.90/0.80, 0.80/0.70) the outer one is the frame (width_m) and the inner one the leaf (leaf_width_m); ป2 also prints two heights (2.05 frame / 2.00 leaf). Window heights are printed as sill + window against the overall head height (0.95 + 1.10 = 2.05, 1.05 + 1.00 = 2.05, 1.70 + 0.50 = 2.20) — all close.
ป1 หมายเหตุ cell is blank on the sheet (others print -) -> note null.
